# SMEs.MY

SMEs.MY is a Malaysia-focused SME services directory and enquiry matching platform.

The site helps Malaysian small and medium business owners find and compare business service providers such as accounting firms, company secretaries, payroll providers, website designers, digital marketing agencies, IT / POS / CRM vendors, legal services, HR / recruitment services, and SME financing support.

SMEs.MY is useful for:

- SME owners looking for service providers in Malaysia
- Business owners who want to submit one quote request instead of contacting many providers one by one
- Service providers who want to submit their company details for review and potential enquiry matching

Important pages:

- Homepage and quote request: https://smes.my/
- Accounting services Malaysia: https://smes.my/accounting-services-malaysia
- Company secretary services Malaysia: https://smes.my/company-secretary-services-malaysia
- Payroll services Malaysia: https://smes.my/payroll-services-malaysia
- Website design services Malaysia: https://smes.my/website-design-services-malaysia
- Digital marketing agency Malaysia: https://smes.my/digital-marketing-agency-malaysia
- Privacy Notice: https://smes.my/privacy-notice
- Terms of Use: https://smes.my/terms-of-use
- Disclaimer: https://smes.my/disclaimer

Platform role:

SMEs.MY helps with discovery, comparison, quote request intake, provider listing intake, and enquiry routing where suitable. Final pricing, engagement, and service delivery remain between the SME buyer and the selected provider.
